bar.name: Four hand-written no-kit apps by a strong model (habits, workouts, budget, journal), blind strips at 412x915

biggest_gap: Chat Undo restores an old data snapshot, so anything the user entered after a change is lost while the chat says 'with your data'; and both blind critics chose the baseline because our charts have no labels and custom screens sit top-left with dead space.

acceptance.line: every demo program renders clean at 5 viewports, light and dark
acceptance.evidence: both critics: 0 console output, 0 overflow, targets >= 44 px, text >= 14 px, contrast >= 4.5:1 on all 15 apps; breaks only near 206 px wide; fonts are fixed px so system text size is ignored
both critics grepped render.mjs and molde.css: no app words in code; only generic draw/rect/arc/grid/box nodes

acceptance.line: edits and undo never lose data entered by the user
acceptance.evidence: Water: scripted change, add 500 ml, Undo -> total drops from 1,980 to 1,480 (the new entry is gone)

acceptance.line: blind critic does not prefer the hand-written no-kit baseline on look and usefulness
acceptance.evidence: both critics picked the baseline: real chart axes and legends, visible primary actions; ours: unlabeled charts, chat button over content, clipped chips

other_notes: S2: chat button floats above the edit sheet and covers part of Done; Undo toast wraps and covers rows; 'what changed' says only 'N lines added' for layout edits; empty states missing for emptied lists; '1 days'.
S2 layout: tasbeeh ring, cricket, tic-tac-toe and savings sit left with the lower half empty (no generic centre/fill rule); heat grid has no weekday labels; charts lack axes and values.
Per-app look scores from the critics: water 4, habits 3-4, budget 3-4, workouts 3-4, journal 3, medicine 4, to-do 3-4, the custom screens 2-3.
